critical_code_review_comments: server.py complete_job lines 1004-1067: auto-charge wrapped in broad try/except → completion NEVER blocks on charge failure. Card-decline path correctly persists last_charge_error/last_charge_attempt_at and DOES NOT set charged_at — verified by code path (CardError branch). Could not exercise live decline path because the only shop_user wired with a PM is Safelite — Gilbert with pm_card_visa and the user-supplied note explicitly advised against mutating that PM. The decline-path verification was confined to code review (lines 1059-1064).

server.py send_eta line 1085: arrival format uses Linux-only '%-I:%M %p' strftime token. On Windows this raises ValueError. Not blocking on Linux container deployments but worth noting for cross-platform CI.
Field.jsx submitCompletion lines 81-83 auto-promotes to on_site if job is still booked/driving before calling /complete — robust and matches backend expectation. Good defensive UX.
Field.jsx line 22 uses 30s polling — fine for MVP; consider websocket/SSE for multi-tech routes.
server.py is now 2504 lines — refactor into routers (field, jobs, billing, portal, public, owner) still overdue (was flagged in iteration 5 as well).
